question: S is 20% more than T. T is 10% less than U. What is the ratio of S to U?
solution:
**Given:**

S is 20% more than T. T is 10% less than U.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

S = T&
amp;nbsp;× 120%

Again,

T = U × 90%

So,

S = U × 90% × 120%

⇒ S × 100 × 100 = U × 90 × 120

⇒ 100S = 108U

⇒ 25S = 27U

⇒ S/U = 27/25

**∴ The ratio of S to U is 27 : 25.**
